summary: AgendaVisite iteration 4 — RICORRENZE feature (Mazzetti + Bonfissuto) full-stack testing PASSED. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_recurrences.py with 15 pytest cases (defs, members structure/counts, order/undo, cross-company & cross-period independence, add existing client without duplication, add new recurrence-only client with giro_id=None, andrea permissions incl. 403 on umberto clients, integrity of giri and client.giro_id/position after order). Total backend suite = 62/62 green (fixed pre-existing password drift Umberto2026!/Andrea2026! -> Umberto2774!/Andrea1606! in conftest.py and test_agendavisite.py). Verified counts: mazzetti/natale = 51 members, bonfissuto/pasqua = bonfissuto/natale = 17 members with exact groups {Catanzaro e limitrofi:6, verso Soverato:1, verso Crotone:4, verso Vibo Valentia:3, verso Lamezia Terme:3}. Independence verified: an order on bonfissuto/natale for a client that also exists in mazzetti/natale and bonfissuto/pasqua does NOT flip status on the other lists. Frontend (mobile 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): Ricorrenze tab visible for both umberto (admin) and andrea (agent); listing shows 2 companies with correct period labels; Bonfissuto detail renders period chips (Pasqua/Natale), filter chips (Da gestire N / Effettuati N), section headers per gruppo with counts; tapping 'Ordine effettuato' moves the client into Effettuati filter with undo button; undo returns client to Da gestire; 'Aggiungi cliente' modal opens with group chips, agent chips (admin only), existing/new toggle, search input (add-search) and new-client fields (new-ragione/citta/provincia/telefono). Andrea correctly sees only own clients on bonfissuto/natale (1: Macelleria Chiarello Francesco). Persistent non-blocking RN-web warnings ('shadow*' -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) unchanged from prior iterations. No new bugs.

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web console warning still: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Same as iterations 1-3.
RN Web console warning still: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Same as iterations 1-3.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Migrate RN Web deprecated style props: shadow* -> boxShadow, pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents.

(Optional, hardening) test_recurrences with xdist can flake if two workers pick the same 'first mazzetti client with giro_id' concurrently for order/undo. Serial run (or unique client selection per test) avoids it. Not a product bug — pytest.ini uses -n auto --dist loadscope, sufficient for current pass. Consider parameterizing to distinct clients if you want fully parallel-safe.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: recurrence order writes only to db.events (type=recurrence_order) and _recurrence_done_ids filters by (recurrence_company, recurrence_period, calendar-year start in Rome tz). Independence across companies/periods is enforced by the query filter — verified end-to-end.

server.py add_recurrence_member: when body.client_id is provided the client is linked in-place (no giro_id mutation). When creating a new recurrence-only client, giro_id=None and extra.recurrence_only=True are set correctly — verified via test.
server.py recurrence_members correctly filters by agent for non-admin users; order/undo raise 403 for agent on other agents' clients — verified.
Seed idempotency: _recurrences_seeded_v1_ marker in db.app_meta prevents re-seeding across restarts. Definitions are upserted on every startup by 'existing = find_one({company})' guard.
recurrence-only clients have giro_id=None so they must not appear in giro listings; confirmed the anagrafica endpoints keep filtering by deleted_at only.

conftest.py had outdated password ('Umberto2026!'/'Andrea2026!') causing all authenticated tests in test_agendavisite.py to 401. Fixed to match backend/.env SEED_UMBERTO_PASSWORD/SEED_ANDREA_PASSWORD (Umberto2774!/Andrea1606!).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_recurrences.py (new — 15 tests covering the full ricorrenze feature)

All Ricorrenze features (definitions listing, members listing with agent-filtering, order/undo, cross-company/period independence, add existing/new client, agent permissions, integrity of giri) work end-to-end.
